notes: 2026-09-07: Single run, slot 6 (infrastructure, observability, deployment) per deterministic date formula (day_of_year 250 % 7 + 1 = 6). Catalogued 4 new: Dagu (mature single-binary local-first workflow/DAG engine, no external DB, built-in MCP server, GPL-3.0 flagged but low practical risk for internal use, USE NOW, 8.5), Duckle (self-hosted ETL/ELT compiling to SQL on DuckDB, git-tracked pipelines, dual MIT/Apache-2.0, beta, PROTOTYPE, 7.6), Pipewright (single-binary all-in-one CI/CD+deploy+ops with auto-HTTPS and per-PR previews, MIT, differentiated from the already-rejected Coolify-alternative wave by including CI, but only 34 stars/2 contributors, PROTOTYPE, 7.5), and Shelve (mature Apache-2.0 secrets/env-var manager with GitHub Actions sync, self-hostable, crowded niche but low-risk, PROTOTYPE, 7.4). Rejected OpenObserve as already-mainstream (21.7k stars, established 2023). Filed Sigillo (agent-safe self-hosted secrets manager, redacts secrets from process stdout so they never reach an LLM context window — genuinely novel angle) as Worth Watching rather than catalogued: README claims MIT but no LICENSE file exists in the repo, and self-hosting is tied specifically to Cloudflare Workers + D1 rather than a generic Docker self-host. Also filed rk8s (Rust, Kubernetes-compatible CRI implementation, 559 stars, architecturally interesting but pushed_at going stale at 6+ weeks) and Regen (self-hosted PagerDuty/incident.io alternative with AI postmortems, directly relevant to the MSSP/PTaaS secondary context, but AGPLv3 — flagged loudly since Sourav runs a hosted SaaS — and only 3 contributors) as Worth Watching. Flagged RunWisp (single Go binary crond/supervisord replacement with a web dashboard, GPL-3.0, 43 stars) as Small but High-Leverage Utility. Rejected as duplicate/immature: a minimalist container-orchestrator micro-niche (gubernator 23★ GPL-3.0, smr 90★ GPL-3.0 stale) redundant with rk8s. GitHub search sorted by 'updated' was extremely noisy (dominated by same-day zero-star template/tracker/list repos); switching to stars+pushed-date qualified queries (stars:>30 pushed:>DATE) produced much better signal and should be the default query shape going forward for non-Show-HN discovery. HN Algolia show_hn query returned low signal for infra/deployment-specific terms this run — GitHub search API carried the bulk of discovery. Did not repeat the full 48-repo release-tag sweep performed on 2026-09-06 (one day prior); material changes across the existing catalog in a 24h window are very unlikely and the turn budget is better spent on new discovery per section 0.5 rule 4. No 'Still Worth Trying' entries yet — oldest catalog entries are first_seen 2026-08-29, 9 days old, still short of the 14-day threshold (starts applying ~2026-09-12).
